name: Amaze
shortDescription: Enemy and player behaviors for aMAZE.
description: Data-driven enemy behavior (stats, roles, state machine, evolution) and player run/meta progression for aMAZE. See docs/neprijatelji.md and docs/progresija.md.

eventsFunctions.description: Replace every enemy that is ready to evolve with an object of the name in its EvolvesTo property. HP percentage, position, rotation and aggro carry over. Call once per frame; the group must contain every object that can be created.
eventsFunctions.name: ProcessEvolutions

events.comment: Only the new object is not marked ready to evolve
The old object is still marked ready to evolve

eventsFunctions.description: Keep at most MaxCorpses corpses: when there are more, the oldest one is destroyed. Call once per frame (it removes one corpse per call).
eventsFunctions.name: LimitCorpses

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Generic enemy: stats, state machine, animations and evolution.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: Enemy

events.comment: One-frame flags are cleared here; scene events read them in the next frame
Aggro: starts when the target gets within range, never stops
Evolution timer: runs from first aggro, even if the player runs away
Last second before evolving: stop and telegraph (Dance for Blob)
Hit reaction: not during an attack or evolution, throttled, ignored with super armor
Movement: straight towards the target (flow-field can replace SetTarget later)
State -> animation (names are the original model animations)

Death: play the animation, destroy when it ends. CurrentAnim must already be Death (it is applied below, one frame later) or the previous animation would be checked. DeathTimeout is a safety net for a Death animation that loops.
The finished Death animation holds its last pose, so a corpse needs no more work
Apply the animation only when it changes

eventsFunctions.description: Set the position the enemy moves towards (the player, or the next flow-field cell).
eventsFunctions.name: SetTarget

eventsFunctions.description: Make the enemy aggressive regardless of distance (e.g. an evolved enemy keeps chasing).
eventsFunctions.name: ForceAggro

eventsFunctions.description: Play the celebration animation (e.g. when the player dies).
eventsFunctions.name: Celebrate

eventsFunctions.description: Play the spawn intro for one second (Wave for Standing models). Used for freshly evolved enemies.
eventsFunctions.name: StartIntro

eventsFunctions.description: Scale max health (+12% per level) and damage (+8% per level) from the level number.
eventsFunctions.name: ApplyLevelScaling

eventsFunctions.description: Check the state: Idle, Move, Attack, Hit, Evolving, Intro, Celebrate or Death.
eventsFunctions.name: IsInState

eventsFunctions.description: True for one frame when the attack lands (melee) or should fire (projectile).
eventsFunctions.name: AttackMoment

eventsFunctions.description: True once the evolve timer has run out. ProcessEvolutions replaces the object.
eventsFunctions.name: IsReadyToEvolve

eventsFunctions.description: True for one frame when death starts (grant XP, drop loot).
eventsFunctions.name: JustDied

eventsFunctions.description: True when the enemy is dead and its Death animation has finished (it stays in the scene).
eventsFunctions.name: IsCorpse

eventsFunctions.description: Seconds since the enemy became a corpse.
eventsFunctions.name: CorpseTime

eventsFunctions.description: Name of the object this enemy evolves into (empty if none).
eventsFunctions.name: EvolutionTarget

propertyDescriptors.label: Time into the attack when it lands or fires (seconds)
propertyDescriptors.name: AttackMomentTime

propertyDescriptors.label: Safety limit: destroy after this many seconds even if Death never ends (looping Death)
propertyDescriptors.name: DeathTimeout

propertyDescriptors.label: Leave a corpse after death (frozen, marks where the player has been)
propertyDescriptors.name: LeaveCorpse

propertyDescriptors.label: Seconds since the corpse was left
propertyDescriptors.name: CorpseAge

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Player run data: XP, run level, meta bonuses, hit invulnerability.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: Player

eventsFunctions.description: Add XP to the run. Levels up as many times as the XP allows.
eventsFunctions.name: AddXP

eventsFunctions.description: Call when the player has picked a perk for one pending level up.
eventsFunctions.name: ConsumeLevelUp
eventsFunctions.sentence: Consume a pending level up of _PARAM0_

eventsFunctions.description: Store the meta level and apply its small bonuses (only if enabled). Call once when the player is created.
eventsFunctions.name: ApplyMetaLevel

eventsFunctions.description: Reset run XP and level (meta level stays).
eventsFunctions.name: ResetRun

eventsFunctions.description: True while there is a level up waiting for a perk choice.
eventsFunctions.name: HasPendingLevelUp

eventsFunctions.description: True for one frame when the run level increased.
eventsFunctions.name: JustLeveledUp

eventsFunctions.description: XP needed to reach the next run level.
eventsFunctions.name: XPToNextLevel

eventsFunctions.description: Damage multiplier including the meta bonus. Multiply the player's damage by this.
eventsFunctions.name: TotalDamageMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Max health bonus per meta level
propertyDescriptors.name: MetaHPPerLevel

propertyDescriptors.label: Highest meta level that still gives power
propertyDescriptors.name: MetaBonusCap
